title: Use an identity
text: Use $$sin\left(2x\right)=2sin\left(x\right) cos\left(x\right)$$, so the integrand is $$2sin\left(x\right) cos^2\left(x\right)$$.

title: Evaluate
text: An antiderivative is $$-\left(\frac{2}{3}\right) cos^3\left(x\right)$$. It has the same value at $$0$$ and at $$2\pi$$.
